sourceFile: 01. TIU L5S3 Result test JIG AWF 2025.11.121_1778470781_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable test-result rows but the changed factor, baseline/test grouping, title, and outcome interpretation are too ambiguous for final Ask AI evidence.
issues: Review title is taken from an unrelated/low-context Sheet1 row rather than the Test sheet title or purpose.
Baseline condition is explicitly not identified, yet the changed factor is framed as a baseline-versus-test comparison.
Changed factor appears to mix jig identity, spot-welding separation, and multiple pin-position conditions without proving which is the primary changed factor.
Outcome fields appear likely misinterpreted: the header shows Input, Ok, Wire Moving, and Frame Deform, but the draft converts values into ng and ratePercent without clear evidence.
Evidence rows cite only result data rows and do not include key context rows such as title, purpose/content, and result header rows needed to interpret the data.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended primary factor the TIU L5S3 test jig, separated spot welding, or the pin-position condition?
Should Wire Moving and Frame Deform be treated as NG categories or separate outcome metrics?
correctionPlan: Replace the review title with the Test sheet title/purpose context.
Define the primary changed factor from source context without inventing a baseline if none is present.
Keep pin positions as subgroup/test-condition keys unless evidence proves they are the primary changed factor.
Rebuild outcomes using the actual header columns: Input, Ok, Wire Moving, and Frame Deform.
Add context evidence rows for title, purpose/content, and the result table header in addition to the result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current row citations are not sufficient for final evidence because they cite result rows but omit the contextual header and changed-condition rows needed to support grouping and metric interpretation.
